versions.changelog:
- Version updated to 0.1.2
- Added: README.md file for improved documentation and usage guidance
- Removed: Deprecated skill-card.md file
- SKILL.md: Updated version number and removed references to resumes as a primary use case for more concise description
- Minor description and usage refinements for better clarity

Initial release: Generate production-quality Persian documents with correct RTL layout and bidirectional text handling.

- Supports DOCX, PDF, and Markdown outputs with Persian/English mixed content.
- Handles numbers, code, URLs, technical terms, tables, lists, headers/footers, and page layout in Persian documents.
- Ensures logical text order and typographically correct, real-world ready output.
- Includes validation steps and a quality checklist to prevent common RTL and bidirectional rendering issues.
- Provides scripts for document generation and validation.
